title: 第19章 领略仙途路修远第20章 课堂突破众人惊
content_zh:
;;
去往天水峰的路上李观棋遇到了许多同期入宗的弟子。
少男少女穿着崭新的宗门服饰，脸上洋溢着对未来的憧憬。
三三两两的聚集在一起，说笑着走向天水峰。
天水峰位于大夏剑宗偏西方的位置。
五大主峰的方位也是按照五行之属规划的。
唯独风、雷、冰、三系主峰单独存在。
就在李观棋羡慕其他人凑在一起说笑的时候，身后突然有两道身影搂住了他的脖子。
“哈哈哈！观棋，想不到你竟然选择了雷系灵根。”
“就是，没想到你竟然还是万中无一的圣品灵根！”
“直接进入内门，可谓是一飞冲天。”
李观棋嘴角露出一抹笑意，来者正是加入了天土峰内门的林东，还有加入了天金峰外门的李盛安。
李观棋微微一笑，最近他也打听了一下二人的情况。
“林东，你也不错，竟然是土系天灵根，日后必定大有前途。”
憨厚的林东挠了挠头，咧嘴笑道：“家里祖坟冒青烟，祖上积德。”
而一旁的李盛安顿时脸上浮现出一丝满足之色。
自顾自的说道：“我这杂灵根能入个外门就不错了。”
三人结伴一起登上了天水峰。
沿途一路上天水峰的弟子竟然九成都是女弟子。
这一路上不少师姐都站在房顶或者高处，不断的交谈打趣着今年新入门的弟子。

“哇，师姐~你看到那个身后背着一块石头的瞎子了么？”
“听说他就是今年天雷峰唯一收的弟子，更是比大师兄武炳更厉害的圣品灵根！”
面容清秀的女子听着耳边师妹叽叽喳喳的声音也只是淡淡一笑。
“李观棋，竟然是一个瞎子取了如此儒雅的名字。”
“天资倒是放眼整个青云大陆都首屈一指。”
“好了，该去练功了。”
熙熙攘攘的人群聚集在了天水峰的大殿之中。
每个人都有一个蒲团，盘膝而坐。
而坐在那里也十分讲究，修仙界更注重尊卑有序，强者为尊。
李观棋还想三人坐在一起，李盛安却说道：“使不得使不得，你现在的身份是天雷峰大长老的关门弟子。”
“也就是比长老门下的核心弟子地位更高的亲传弟子。”
“你要坐在最前方的！”
李观棋环顾四周，发现周围的人脸色都有些不自然，无奈只好走到最前方。
那个蒲团孤零零的只有一个，身后则是入门的内门弟子，再往后就是外门弟子。
这次大夏剑宗广开山门，共计收徒三百九十二人，算得上是收取弟子比较多的时候了。
其中直接进入内门修行的弟子，共计六十余人，其中身具天灵根者，四人。
即便是天灵根，也并非就会被长老看重收为门下弟子。
李观棋盘膝在地，面前是一方案几，同样也有一方蒲团。
刷！
一阵清风拂过，身穿冰蓝长袍的女子凭空出现在案几之后。

脸色严肃的女子正是天水峰三长老蓝禾，金丹后期的境界。
蓝禾一双美眸看到还有许多蒲团空着，顿时脸色一沉。
挥手间大殿的门轰然关闭，外面奔跑而来的弟子顿时面色一苦。

On the way to Tianshui Peak, Li Guanqi met many disciples who had joined the sect at the same time.
The boys and girls were wearing brand new sect costumes, their faces filled with longing for the future.
They gathered together in twos and threes, chatting and laughing as they walked towards Tianshui Peak.
Tianshui Peak is located in the west of Daxia Jianzong.
The positions of the five main peaks are also planned according to the five elements.
Only the main peaks of wind, thunder, ice and three systems exist alone.
Just when Li Guanqi was envious of the others chatting and laughing together, two figures suddenly hugged his neck from behind.
"Hahaha! Watching the chess game, I didn't expect you to choose the lightning spiritual root."
"That's right, I didn't expect you to be the only one in the world with a holy spiritual root!"
"Going directly into the inner gate is like a leap into the sky."
A smile appeared on Li Guanqi's lips. The visitors were Lin Dong, who had joined the inner sect of Tiantu Peak, and Li Sheng'an, who had joined the outer sect of Tianjin Peak.
Li Guanqi smiled slightly. Recently, he also inquired about the situation of the two of them.
"Lin Dong, you are not bad either. You actually have the earth element of heavenly spiritual roots. You will definitely have a bright future in the future."
The honest and honest Lin Dong scratched his head and said with a grin: "There is smoke coming out of the ancestral graves at home, and the ancestors have accumulated good deeds."
Li Sheng'an on the side suddenly had a look of satisfaction on his face.
He said to himself, "It would be great if my miscellaneous spiritual roots can enter the outer sect."
The three of them climbed Tianshui Peak together.
Ninety percent of the disciples who came to Tianshui Peak along the way were female disciples.
Along the way, many senior sisters were standing on rooftops or high places, chatting and teasing the new disciples this year.
"Wow, senior sister~ Have you seen the blind man carrying a stone behind his back?"
"I heard that he is the only disciple accepted by Tianlei Peak this year, and he has a more powerful Saint Grade Spiritual Root than Senior Brother Wu Bing!"
The woman with a delicate face just smiled faintly when she heard the chirping voice of her junior sister.
"Li Guanqi, it turned out that a blind man had such an elegant name."
"Talent is second to none in the entire Qingyun Continent."
"Okay, it's time to practice."
A bustling crowd gathered in the main hall of Tianshui Peak.
Everyone has a futon and sits cross-legged.
And sitting there is also very particular. The world of immortality pays more attention to the order of respect and inferiority, and the strong is respected.
Li Guanqi also wanted the three of them to sit together, but Li Sheng'an said: "No, no, no, you are now a close disciple of the great elder of Tianleifeng."
"That is, the direct disciples who have a higher status than the core disciples under the elder's sect."
"You have to sit at the front!"
Li Guanqi looked around and found that the faces of the people around him were a little unnatural, so he had no choice but to walk to the front.
There is only one futon, and behind it are the inner disciples who have started, and behind them are the outer disciples.
This time the Great Xia Sword Sect opened its gates and accepted a total of 392 disciples, which can be regarded as a time when it has accepted more disciples.
Among them, there are more than sixty disciples who have directly entered the inner sect to practice, and four of them have heavenly spiritual roots.
Even if he has Tianlinggen, he will not be valued by the elders and accepted as a disciple.
Li Guan was kneeling on the chessboard, with a plan and several tables in front of him, as well as a futon.
brush!
A breeze blew by, and a woman wearing an ice-blue robe appeared out of thin air behind the desk.
The woman with a serious face is Lan He, the third elder of Tianshui Peak, who is in the late stage of Jindan.
Lan He's beautiful eyes suddenly darkened when he saw that there were still many empty futons.
With a wave of his hand, the door of the main hall slammed shut, and the disciples running outside suddenly looked bitter.
